Core-reached/execution notifications and _AtlasSignalStrength shader global stage into owner fields; Shader.SetGlobalFloat only in FlushQueuedAtlasSignalStrength from LateFrameTick.
First-hour guidance/reminder notifications stage fixed-char pending payloads and flush in LateFrameTick.
SlowTick stale-volume queue saturation no longer calls FlushPendingDespawns; it publishes numeric telemetry and lets LateFrameTick own despawn/material reset.

Tick completion/cancel action audio no longer calls IAudioService.PlayAtPoint; action audio stages clip+position and drains in LateFrameTick. Consumable effect path uses no-audio consumable route.
Added TryConsumeWithoutAudio so delayed action completion can apply consumable truth without direct PlayStatic2D.
